name: Charcuterie
body:
Station and Complexity garde manger 4

Flavor Profiles umami, salty, spicy, texture
Additional Ingredients bitter, sour, or sweet

EFFECT

Duration 1 hour/level, or 1 minute when consumed; Serving Size 1d6+2

DESCRIPTION

Charcuterie is an array of preserved and prepared meats, cheeses, fruits, and vegetables.

When consumed, it grants one of the following feats as a bonus feat for 1 minute (each creature chooses separately). Improved Initiative, Power Attack, Skill Focus, or Toughness. The additional hit points granted by Toughness are treated as temporary hit points.

Additional ingredients increase the serving size by +1 each and add Stand Still (bitter), Combat Casting (sour), or Mobility (sweet) to the list of choices. Creatures don’t have to meet the prerequisites of these feats.
